43fc695a5d643e990cd294dd390673d1422884fd.QuestDescription: Now,it would be foolish to go in blind 'ere,so I be creatin' some tiny spies to gather information for Vol'jin. He got to know what's goin' on over on de islands.$B$BI could use da help,if you be feelin' up to it. I tell ya how it's done. First,ya gotta catch de frogs. Dey like to stay in de shade of da palm trees around Sen'jin.$B$BOnce ya have de frogs,bring 'em over here to my sentry totem an' attune dem to me sight.

43fd8ad5de1915f58ddb0cd8ef3668b17e444821.Text: Magtoor, thank you for allowing me to stay here with you.  I'm sure that there is much that we can learn from each other.  And I'm eager to learn all that I can of the Lost Ones to the east.

43ff8650a3be8d3256270597e763c729c6d3c9ba.Text: Self-destruct sequence finalized. Have a nice day.
